summaries.summary: Foundry User is Microsoft's Azure RBAC role for Foundry, renamed from Azure AI User with the same role ID (53ca6127-db72-4b80-b1b0-d745d6d5456d) and permissions. It is the least-privilege role for developers building and testing agents: reader access to the Foundry resource and project plus all Microsoft.CognitiveServices data actions, including listkeys. Minimum setup assigns it to the developer and the project managed identity; old names may still appear, so use the GUID in code.

The gcloud CLI is Google Cloud's command-line tool, currently version 593.0.0 (2026-11-10), installable on Windows via winget with bundled Python now required. It handles sign-in (gcloud auth login, application-default login for ADC, print-access-token), service account impersonation and workload identity federation credential files. Agent work uses gcloud ai, agent-registry and agent-identity groups; the old MCP command groups were removed in favor of Agent Registry. bq ships with it.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (gemini-3.8-flash) is Google's stable workhorse Gemini API model, GA since 2026-09-02, which replaced gemini-3.7-flash on 2026-10-08. It currently costs $0.75 input / $3.75 output per 1M tokens, rising to $1.50/$7.50 on 2027-01-01.

Gemini 4 Carbon (gemini-4-carbon) is a Google Gemini API model, GA since 2026-11-10. It currently costs $2.00/$10.00 per 1M input/output tokens, rising to $4.00/$20.00 on 2026-12-01. In Gemini Enterprise it is global-only, so enabling it routes traffic to the global location, which matters for data residency.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen (gemini-4-hydrogen) is a Google Gemini model, GA on 2026-11-12 in both the Gemini API and Agent Platform (685 tokens/sec per GSU of Provisioned Throughput). It has a 1,048,576-token context, 65,536-token default output, thinking levels up to xhigh, and supports function calling, code execution, computer use, File Search and grounding, but not the Live API or explicit caching. It costs $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens; cache writes bill at 1.25x input from 2027-01-12.

The Gemini API is Google AI's developer API at generativelanguage.googleapis.com (v1 stable, v1beta for agents and new features), authenticated with a Gemini API key in x-goog-api-key; docs now live at aistudio.google.com/docs. Billing defaults to Prepay (HTTP 402 at zero balance), rate limits are per project and return 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Data residency requires the Cloud platform instead. Sampling parameters were deprecated 2026-07-21, and EEA/Swiss/UK users get Paid Services terms only.

A Gemini API auth key is Google's authorization key type bound to a Google Cloud service account, so requests run under that identity rather than just billing a project. All newly created AI Studio keys have been auth keys since 2026-05-28, and Cloud console keys must each be bound to a service account. Auth keys are restricted to the Generative Language API by default and support fast enforcement against leaked keys.

The Gemini API CLI (gemini-api) is Google's open-source, stateless command-line client over the Interactions API, in beta since 2026-10-27. It installs on Windows via a PowerShell script or with go install, stores the API key in the OS keychain via gemini-api configure, and covers generation, media, agents, environments, credentials, webhooks, triggers and files. Breaking changes can occur between minor versions, so pin a release in CI.

Gemini API function calling is Google's tool-use mechanism for Gemini models, with tool_choice values auto (default), any, none and validated, allowed_tools to restrict choices, and parallel and chained calls. Gemini 4 and 3 models can combine built-in tools with custom functions in one turn (preview since 2026-03-18). Google recommends at most 10 to 20 active tools, and large or deeply nested schemas can fail with 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT because only an OpenAPI subset is supported.

A Gemini API key is Google's credential for the Gemini Developer API, belonging to a Google Cloud project that holds billing and permissions; the Cloud Gemini platform uses IAM instead. Creating one needs Cloud IAM permissions such as apikeys.keys.create and iam.serviceAccounts.create. Requests send it in x-goog-api-key, and SDKs read GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY (GOOGLE_API_KEY wins). Gemini CLI also accepts it via GEMINI_API_KEY.

Gemini API Managed Agents is Google's configurable agent harness, in public preview since 2026-05-19, where one API call provisions an Ubuntu sandbox for reasoning, code execution, files and browsing. It hosts the Antigravity and Deep Research agents and allows up to 1,000 agents per project. Outbound network is unrestricted by default (an allowlist can restrict it), secrets are injected by an egress proxy, idle environments are deleted after 7 days, and compute is unbilled during preview.

The Gemini app is Google's chat assistant, included on Workspace Business Starter through Enterprise plans. Most Business, Enterprise and similar editions get it as a core service with enterprise data protections, while others get it under consumer terms where chats may be human-reviewed. Admins with the Gemini Settings privilege turn it on or off by OU or group, and can allow all users regardless of license. History is kept 3, 18 (default) or 36 months.

The Gemini Batch API (/v1beta/batches) is Google's asynchronous Gemini API endpoint, priced at 50% of standard with a 24-hour turnaround target. It takes inline requests under 20 MB or JSONL files up to 2 GB, supports generateContent and batch embeddings, and expires jobs over 48 hours. Quotas include 100 concurrent batches, 20 GB file storage and per-model enqueued-token caps by tier.

Gemini CLI is Google's open-source terminal coding agent (npm @google/gemini-cli, currently 0.68.0, Node.js 20+). Since 2026-06-18 it no longer serves personal free, AI Pro or AI Ultra accounts, which are pointed to Antigravity CLI; Code Assist Standard/Enterprise licenses, paid Gemini API keys and Vertex AI auth still work. Auth options are Sign in with Google, GEMINI_API_KEY, or Vertex AI via ADC, service account or Cloud API key. MCP servers are configured in settings.json or with gemini mcp add.

Gemini Code Assist is Google's AI coding assistant for IDEs and Cloud tools, with agent mode using system tools and MCP servers. It is being wound down: free and AI Pro/Ultra tiers stopped 2026-06-18, Standard and Enterprise reached end of sale 2026-10-09 (existing subscriptions auto-renew through 2026), and Gemini Enterprise bundles drop it, with existing entitlements ending 2027-03-31. Google points customers to Antigravity and Antigravity CLI.

Gemini Computer Use is Google's Gemini API computer_use tool, GA since 2026-10-30, for browser, mobile or desktop control on gemini-4 models, gemini-3.8-flash and others; the older 2.5 preview model is shut down. Responses can require user confirmation, which the client must acknowledge with safety_acknowledgement, and coordinates are normalized to 0-999. Optional prompt-injection detection scans screenshots on newer models.

Gemini Enterprise is Google Cloud's enterprise agent and search app, built on the Discovery Engine API, sold in Business, Standard, Plus, Frontline and Pay-as-you-go editions. Access uses roles/discoveryengine.agentspaceAdmin and agentspaceUser, licenses, and Google Identity or Workforce Identity Federation set per location (global, us, eu, in-country). It registers ADK agents on Agent Runtime and A2A agents (v0.3, GA 2026-08-17) under a pooled daily creation quota, and is governed via Agent Registry and Agent Gateway.

Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is Google Cloud's AI and agent platform, renamed from Vertex AI on 2026-04-22, organized into Build, Scale, Govern and Optimize; the API remains aiplatform.googleapis.com and roles keep the roles/aiplatform.* prefix. Day-one access needs roles/aiplatform.user, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser on the runtime account, enabled APIs, region and VPC-SC details. It offers Claude models up to Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, with a 30,000 RPM inference quota per region.

Gemini Enterprise Business edition is Google's small-team tier for 1-500 users with 25 GiB pooled index storage per user. It is a web SaaS app at business.gemini.google.com, so admins need no Google Cloud console access, project numbers or project-level IAM roles. Third-party sources report about $21 per seat per month; signup, trial and identity requirements are unconfirmed.

Gemini Enterprise data connectors are Google's links to Google sources (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, BigQuery, Spanner) and third-party sources such as SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow and Salesforce. Ingestion connectors enforce source ACLs through identity and full syncs, while federated connectors query sources live and send query text and conversation history to the third-party backend. Many federated connectors reached GA during 2026, most recently Salesforce on 2026-11-03.

Gemini Enterprise Frontline edition is Google's tier for frontline workers, requiring 150 or more Standard or Plus users and providing 2 GiB pooled index storage per user. Frontline users can only use admin-provisioned agents, cannot create custom skills, and get no agent creation quota.

A Gemini Enterprise license is Google's per-user entitlement, required for any access and for creating agents in Agent Gallery or Workflow Builder; removing one ends access immediately. Licenses are distributed to a specific project and location, so a user in two multi-regions needs two. Distributing them needs roles/billing.admin on the billing account, and console distribution and reclaim have been GA since 2026-06-25.

Gemini File Search is Google's managed RAG tool in the Gemini API, in public preview since 2025-11-06 with multimodal search added 2026-05-05 (image search needs gemini-embedding-2). It uses fileSearchStores resources with upload or import ingestion and metadata filters. Only indexing embeddings are billed; documents are capped at 100 MB and project storage from 1 GB (Free) to 1 TB (Tier 3). It cannot be used in the Live API or combined with Google Search or URL context.

Gemini in Workspace is Google's generative AI built into Workspace apps, included with Workspace plans (Gemini in Docs from Business Standard up). Customer content is not used to train models outside the domain without permission, chats are not human-reviewed without permission, and Gemini only sees content the user can already access. Prompts are retained 90 days to indefinitely as admins set, and certifications include SOC, ISO 27001/42001, FedRAMP High and HIPAA.

The Gemini Live API is Google's stateful WebSocket API for real-time voice and video, taking 16 kHz PCM audio, JPEG frames and text and returning 24 kHz audio, in 70 languages with function calling and Google Search tools. Current models are gemini-3.8-live and gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking (GA 2026-09-15). Client apps can use ephemeral tokens from /v1beta/auth_tokens. Sessions last 15 minutes audio-only or 2 minutes with video without compression; it is v1beta only.

Gemini Notebook Enterprise is Google's enterprise notebook research tool, renamed from NotebookLM Enterprise on 2026-07-16, sold standalone or with Gemini Enterprise. Sign-in needs roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser, and role names still say NotebookLM; project-level discoveryengine.notebooks.get exposes every notebook. It supports Cloud Identity or third-party IdPs, and sharing stays within the project. Hostnames drop 'lm' on 2026-11-16 (notebook.cloud.google.com), which may require allowlist updates.

The Gemini Notebook Enterprise API is Google's Discovery Engine v1alpha REST API for notebooks, supporting create, get, listRecentlyViewed, batchDelete and share. It requires a licensed user account with roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser and rejects service accounts. The page says Preview though release notes record GA on 2025-09-05; batchDelete returns empty even for missing notebooks, and ownership cannot be transferred.

The Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint is Google's beta OpenAI-style interface at generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/, using a Gemini API key as the bearer token. It supports chat completions with streaming, tools and structured output, reasoning_effort, images, embeddings, batch, service tiers and models. Batch file upload and download through the OpenAI library are unsupported, reasoning cannot be turned off for Gemini 3 or 4, and xhigh works only with gemini-4-hydrogen.

The Gen AI evaluation service is Google's Agent Platform tool for scoring models and agents with adaptive per-prompt rubrics, defaulting to GENERAL_QUALITY. Agent metrics include final_response_quality, hallucination and tool_use_quality. The SDK flow is generate_rubrics, run_inference, then evaluate, partly marked Preview. Quota is 1,000 RPM and 20 concurrent runs per project per region.

generative-ai-family is Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's aggregate IAM resource type for Generative AI, granted with policies like 'allow group <group> to manage generative-ai-family in compartment <c>'; Oracle recommends the full family only for admins or sandboxes. Engagements should request a compartment-scoped group policy. API keys and Generative AI Agents need any-user policies conditioned on principal type. Whether it covers generative-ai-response, semantic-store and nl2sql is unconfirmed.

Genie Agents are Databricks' no-code natural-language data agents, renamed from Genie Spaces on 2026-07-08 and now recommended over legacy Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent; APIs still use /api/2.0/genie/spaces. Billing is pay-as-you-go DBUs, with user usage free through 2027-01-31 but service principal usage billed. Granting an agent access also requires access to underlying tables, warehouses and UC functions. Limits are 50 tables per agent and 10,000 messages per conversation.

The Genie Agents Conversation API is Databricks' GA REST API for starting conversations, sending messages and fetching or executing query results under /api/2.0/genie/spaces/{space_id}. Callers need at least CAN VIEW on the agent and SELECT on the data. Rate limits appear as RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_* errors; poll every 1-5 seconds with backoff up to 60 seconds and stop after 10 minutes.

Genie One is Databricks' account-level natural-language analytics product grounded in Genie Ontology. It moved to pay-as-you-go DBU billing on 2026-07-08, with user usage free through 2027-01-31. Genie Slack and Teams apps went GA on 2026-11-09, and a Claude connector plus ChatGPT and Cursor plugins were announced on 2026-11-11.

The Genie One API is Databricks' Beta API at /api/2.0/genie/one, where POST /responses returns an SSE stream and other endpoints manage conversations. It needs an OAuth token with the genie scope (U2M or M2M) and a workspace admin to enable the preview. Each request takes one question up to 25,000 bytes, a second question during an active response returns 409, and rate limits return 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.

The Genie One MCP server is Databricks' GA (since 2026-09-25) Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at the workspace's /ai-gateway/mcp-services/system.ai.genie_one_mcp path, exposing tools such as genie_ask and genie_poll_response. It accepts OAuth U2M, M2M or a PAT, with on-behalf-of OAuth needing the ai-gateway scope. Callers need EXECUTE on system.ai.genie_one_mcp plus USE CATALOG and USE SCHEMA. Migrating from /api/2.0/mcp/genie means changing the URL and scope only.

GitHub Actions is GitHub's CI/CD service whose OIDC tokens enable keyless federation to clouds and AI platforms. AWS uses an IAM OIDC provider and sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity with aud/sub conditions; Entra, Google Cloud, Databricks and the OpenAI API also accept its tokens. Jobs need id-token: write. Google requires an attribute condition since the issuer is shared, and repos created or renamed from 2026-07-15 use numeric-ID subjects in Databricks federation policies.

Agent Development Kit (ADK) is Google's open-source, code-first agent framework for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and Kotlin; Python google-adk is at 2.14.1 (Python 3.11+). It supports multiple model providers, MCP tools, A2A and graph workflows, and deploys to Agent Runtime, Cloud Run or GKE. On Cloud Run, sessions are lost without external session and artifact services. Registering ADK agents in Gemini Enterprise needs agentspaceAdmin and Agent Runtime hosting in a matching location.

Google Cloud is Google's cloud platform, hosting Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and the service agents agents depend on, such as Cloud Run, Apigee, BigQuery Connection and Agent Gateway service agents. Its docs moved to docs.cloud.google.com with 301 redirects, offer Markdown via a .md.txt suffix, and have no site-level llms.txt. The status page is status.cloud.google.com. Snowflake accounts can also run on Google Cloud.

Google Cloud Agent Identity gives each agent a SPIFFE-based IAM principal with an auto-renewed 24-hour X.509 certificate and certificate-bound tokens (DPoP/mTLS) by default; it works on Agent Runtime, Gemini Enterprise, Cloud Run and GKE. Agent identities get roles/aiplatform.agentDefaultAccess and agentContextEditor by default, and Google advises against project-level roles/aiplatform.user. GA status on Agent Runtime is disputed across docs. Deleting an agent leaves bindings, and redeploys create new principals.

Agent Runtime (formerly Vertex AI Agent Engine, still the ReasoningEngine API) is Google Cloud's managed runtime for containerized agents, with ADK, LangChain, LangGraph and other templates, sandboxes, sessions, Memory Bank and A2A support. Deploying needs roles/aiplatform.user and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser for custom service accounts; the default identity is the Reasoning Engine service agent, or Agent Identity via identity_type. Default quota is 90 queries per minute per region; billing is per vCPU-hour and GiB-hour.

Google Cloud remote MCP servers are Google-managed HTTPS MCP endpoints, mostly at SERVICE.googleapis.com/mcp, supporting MCP version 2026-07-28; 87 are listed across Google Cloud, non-Cloud and Workspace groups. Cloud servers are governed by IAM, need roles/mcp.toolUser, and are enabled by enabling the product API. Clients authenticate with ADC, an OAuth client or a bearer token plus x-goog-user-project; pasted tokens expire in about an hour. Many servers carry no stage label.

A Google Cloud service account is a non-human IAM identity, either user-managed, default or a Google-managed service agent. Attaching one to a resource needs roles/iam.serviceAccountUser and managing one needs roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin. The Cloud Gemini platform uses service accounts and IAM rather than API keys, and Gemini API keys must now be bound to one. Cloud IAM roles grant no Workspace data; access needs file sharing, an admin role or domain-wide delegation.

Google Gemini models are Google's foundation model family, also hosted on platforms like Databricks and Snowflake Cortex. Current models include Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Carbon and Argon, plus Gemini 3.8, 3.7 and 3.5 Flash. On Databricks most are global endpoints needing cross-geography routing. Models older than Gemini 3 are not served on multi-region endpoints, and calling an unsupported endpoint type returns 404. Several 2.5 and 3.1 preview endpoints retired 2026-07-09.

The Google Gen AI SDK is Google's GA client library family for Gemini: Python google-genai (3.3.0, Python 3.11+), @google/genai, Go, Java and .NET; legacy google-generativeai SDKs were deprecated 2025-11-30. The same SDK targets the Gemini API with a key or Agent Platform via vertexai=True or enterprise=True, or with GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION=global and GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_ENTERPRISE=True. Direct MCP session support is unconfirmed.
